::: {#exm-equal-tailed-interval}
#### Equal-tailed interval for a Gaussian posterior

In @exm-normal-normal,
the posterior of $\mean$ is Gaussian
with mean $\frac{n}{n+1}\bar x$ and standard deviation $1/\sqrt{n+1}$,
so the 95% equal-tailed credible interval is
$\frac{n}{n+1}\bar x \pm 1.96/\sqrt{n+1}$.
With $n = 20$, the interval's half-width is $1.96/\sqrt{21} \approx 0.43$.
:::
